Journal

Behind the music, and other quiet updates.

  1. No. 482026-11-25 17:50 KST · behind-the-music

    How Many Words Are in a Lyric Line?

    The 673 lines of the English lyric sheets of dear(you); vol.1 average 3.8 words, and no line runs past nine. Four-word lines are the most common, and the Outro has the shortest lines.

  2. No. 472026-11-24 16:38 KST · behind-the-music

    Starting a Line With And, But or Because

    70 of the 673 lines in the English lyric sheets of dear(you); vol.1 begin with and, but, because or so. Every song has at least five, and "or" never opens a line.

  3. No. 462026-11-21 17:39 KST · behind-the-music

    Where the English Lyric Lines Stop

    In the English lyric sheets of dear(you); vol.1, 265 of 673 lines end with a period, 150 with a comma and 207 with no mark. A period is never followed by a lowercase line.

  4. No. 452026-11-20 16:26 KST · behind-the-music

    Window, Coffee and Rain in Ten Songs

    In the English lyric sheets of dear(you); vol.1, the room is barely described. Window, coffee, rain, lights, room and phone add up to 19 words, and 7 are in song 05.

  5. No. 442026-11-19 12:47 KST · behind-the-music

    No and Not in Ten Songs

    The English lyric sheets of dear(you); vol.1 hold 50 negative words in 2,554. "Don't" leads with 13, and 11 of those are the phrase "you don't have to".

  6. No. 432026-11-18 15:09 KST · behind-the-music

    Lines That Come Back in Ten Songs

    In the English lyric sheets of dear(you); vol.1, 630 of 673 lines are distinct. The 43 extra repeats are mostly one- or two-word lines, and song 06 has the most.

  7. No. 422026-11-17 12:53 KST · behind-the-music

    Subtitle Cues in the Shorts Clips

    The Shorts clips of dear(you); vol.1 come with subtitle files of about 58 seconds. In the ten English ones, 128 cues cover 521 seconds, and the longest single cue, 10.9 seconds, is in song 05.

  8. No. 412026-11-16 16:25 KST · behind-the-music

    How Korean Lyric Lines End

    Of 679 Korean lines in the ten lyric sheets of dear(you); vol.1, only three end in the polite 요 and 15 in 다. The most common last syllable is 도, with 80 lines.

  9. No. 402026-11-15 12:12 KST · behind-the-music

    No Exclamation Marks in Ten Lyric Sheets

    Across both versions of the ten lyric sheets of dear(you); vol.1 there is no exclamation mark at all. The English lines hold 14 question marks, 29 dashes and 5 ellipses, and three songs ask nothing.

  10. No. 392026-11-14 15:21 KST · behind-the-music

    Which Section Runs Longest

    In the English lyric sheets of dear(you); vol.1 the Chorus averages 9.9 lines, shorter than both Verses and the Bridge. The first four songs have longer choruses, and the last four all have exactly nine lines.
